comment: The interoperability capability is described as something to be “deployed” centrally or distributively. This wording risks recreating the idea that interoperability is a deployable component rather than a combination of standards, governance, services, and implementation mechanisms.

anchor.note: p.92 l.Lines 164-166 read as the printed page; section 4.2.2 agrees

public.text: The interoperability capability is described as something to be “deployed” centrally or distributively. This wording risks recreating the idea that interoperability is a deployable component rather than a combination of standards, governance, services, and implementation mechanisms.
public.suggestedRevision: Replace with a sentence like: “Establish the interoperability capability by publishing specifications, governance and trust arrangements, implementing the necessary exchange mechanisms, and enabling conformant endpoints.”
